sealed_statement.cover: For every fixed seed size s, every actual source-valid ordered seven-tuple in the declared final-state scope, using roles from S,B=U,C=Y0 representative,X0 and containing at least one C and one X0, maps by a deterministic extraction Phi to a cell in a finite canonical annotation space.
preserved_local_data: ordered role classes and all 21 concrete adjacency bits
canonical seed coloring and dynamic source-type bitsets tau(B)
chi_S(B), source L_P(B), chi_X0(B), exact A(B)
component partition of selected C roles
restricted dynamic-component incidence / D_C on selected B roles
canonical component message_type_id with MIN_BAD replay certificate
fixed X0 colors, local incidence profiles, and color-redundancy annotations needed by the local census
sealed_statement.finite_parameterization: The grammar is finite for each fixed s=|S|. Exact finite constants include 12138 role strings with at least one C and X0, at most Bell(7)=877 component partitions, 21 adjacency bits, 16 four-color masks, and at most 168 monotone component-message types.
sealed_statement.coverage_not_realizability: The grammar is a one-way cover and may contain unrealizable cells. No exact-realizability converse is sealed.
sealed_statement.abstraction_boundary: Unbounded internal component structure is not enumerated. C0 message type and representative/local masks are retained; any downstream conclusion that needs more internal information remains UNKNOWN unless an exact adequacy theorem supplies it.
sealed_statement.local_identity_quotient: Same-color X0 identities may be represented locally by fixed color plus local role-incidence/cross-X0 profile for seven-role census purposes. This does not imply global source equivalence.
sealed_statement.semantic_firewall: Representation delta and extension delta are separate. mu_C and MIN_BAD are equivalent representations of one component function; the actual boundary relation R_C depends jointly on mu_C and D_C.
